name: merkle_proofs
description: A Merkle inclusion proof per kural (RFC 9162, SHA-256) against the two roots in MANIFEST.json and the card: the exact tree pins the text byte for byte, the letters tree pins its compare_key so a quote that differs only in spacing or punctuation also checks. Anyone can verify a quote offline with one root and the 5 to 11 hashes here.

fields.name: leaf_index
fields.description: Position of the kural's leaf in both trees, 0 to 1329 (kural number minus 1).

fields.name: exact_path
fields.description: Audit path in the exact tree, hex SHA-256, leaf to root. The leaf is canonical JSON {id, n, text} of kurals.text_ta.

fields.name: letters_path
fields.description: Audit path in the letters tree. The leaf is canonical JSON {id, n, key} with key = quote_keys.compare_key.
